title: Coinsurance Cost-Sharing Split by Tier for Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
Each tier of Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage is defined by the supplemental protection on file and splits each coinsurance day between the resident and, where there is one, a secondary payer.

| Tier | Medigap plan letters on file that place a coverage in the tier | Verified QMB status required | Resident share of each coinsurance day | Secondary share | Secondary liable party | Balance billing prohibited |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part A Without Supplemental Coverage | NONE (no Medigap policy) | No | 100% | 0% | None | No |
| Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan A or B | A, B | No | 100% | 0% | None | No |
| Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan K | K | No | 50% | 50% | Medigap carrier | No |
| Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan L | L | No | 25% | 75% | Medigap carrier | No |
| Medicare Part A with Full-Coinsurance Medigap | C, D, F, G, M, N | No | 0% | 100% | Medigap carrier | No |
| Medicare Part A with QMB Medicaid Crossover | NONE, A, B, C, D, F, G, K, L, M, N | Yes | 0% | 100% | State Medicaid crossover | Yes |

**Effective dates (all six tiers):**

- A newly reported Medigap policy changes the cost-sharing split from the carrier's policy effective date.
- QMB protection takes effect 1 month after the month of the state's QMB determination, that is, on the first day of the following month.

*Hypothetical illustration:* with a QMB determination dated in the middle of a month, QMB protection starts on the first day of the next month; with a Medigap policy whose carrier effective date is the 23rd, the new split starts on the 23rd.
